product_one_liner.value: Vectary is a browser-based design platform that helps designers, marketers and creative teams develop concepts with AI and create, collaborate on and share interactive 3D presentations and augmented-reality experiences.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 18 employees; the band reflects that count, not the broader 11–50 company-size category.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product announcements, design tutorials and marketing/workflow articles rather than two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public Vectary jobs board states “No jobs to discover at this time.”

model_provider.value: Hunyuan 3.1; Hunyuan 3; Tripo H3.1; Tripo 2.5; Pixal 3D; Trellis 2; Trellis; Meshy 6; Meshy 5; Rodin 2
model_provider.notes: These are the AI models explicitly listed for image-to-3D generation, rather than an inferred hosting provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page claims SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulation rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Both funding profiles identify January 25, 2023 as the latest round and report $4.6 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round, January 25, 2023, predates May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public Vectary jobs board states “No jobs to discover at this time.”

launched_6mo.notes: The May 20, 2026 release added new AI image-to-3D models, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Roberto A.’s profile dates his Vectary Chief Revenue Officer tenure January 2023–May 2026, establishing a C-level departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Vectary explicitly names Hubspot among its service providers.
